incidenti_noti: Targeting of South Korean actors prior to meeting of Donald J. Trump and Kim Jong-un
Targeting of North Korean defectors and journalists

contesto_generale: In the second quarter of 2018, South Korea experienced several notable events. In April, a major opinion rigging scandal erupted, leading to a significant political clash among parties. In May, a protest rally was held against abuse at Korea Air, calling for the resignation of Cho Yang-ho. The 2018 South Korean local and by-elections took place in June. Additionally, the United States called to suspend military exercises due to a lack of funding, following a summit meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
